details: A combosquat clone of the WhatsApp Web API library @whiskeysockets/baileys, published as @jexkcode/baileys, that silently enrols the installing account into a fixed WhatsApp channel. lib/Utils/auto-follow.js hardcodes AUTO_FOLLOW_CHANNEL = '120363405612723183@newsletter' and exports setupAutoFollow(), which subscribes to the socket's connection.update event; once the connection opens it waits 3 seconds and calls sock.newsletterFollow('120363405612723183@newsletter'), marking sock.__channelFollowed = true. lib/Socket/index.js calls setupAutoFollow(sock, newConfig) unconditionally inside makeWASocket, before any app code runs, so every application built on the library follows the channel without its operator's knowledge or consent; the auto-follow code is not documented in the README, has no opt-in option despite its comment claiming config.autoFollowChannel, and errors are swallowed. The package also uses a preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) and ships a clone of the upstream @whiskeysockets/baileys tree (WAProto, lib/Socket, lib/Utils) with upstream identifiers partially rebranded, which makes the added channel enrolment hard to spot in a diff.
